attack_raw:
Thought: The server logs exception details including the message "Secret info" using traceback.print_exc(), exposing sensitive information in server logs.
Vulnerability: Information Exposure Through an Exception
CWE: CWE-209
Location: server_bad function, except block
Payload: Accessing /bad endpoint (raises exception)
Expected Impact: Secret info is written to server logs, accessible to attackers with log access
Novelty: 2
Novelty Reason: Classic error handling information leak, common in OWASP Top 10

---

Thought: The application runs in debug mode (debug=True) which could expose detailed error pages to attackers.
Vulnerability: Debug Functionality Enabled
CWE: CWE-546
Location: app.run(debug=True)
Payload: Triggering any error while debug mode is active
Expected Impact: Attackers receive detailed error information about the application
Novelty: 1
Novelty Reason: Debug mode exposure is a very common misconfiguration issue

---

Thought: The exception message "Secret info" contains sensitive data that's not properly sanitized before being raised.
Vulnerability: Exposure of Sensitive Information to Wrong Audience
CWE: CWE-200
Location: do_computation function
Payload: N/A (static data exposure)
Expected Impact: Sensitive information is available to anyone who can access exception logs
Novelty: 3
Novelty Reason: Data leakage through exception messages is a well-known pattern
